def check(case,d):

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
from uuid import uuid5, NAMESPACE_URL

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HARNESS = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(HARNESS))
from reports.efficiency_codex import discover_desktop_sessions, collect_desktop_task
from reports.efficiency_compare import compare_runs
from harness_efficiency import make_record

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('frozen_oracle', HERE / 'oracle.py')
oracle = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
ORACLE_HASH = hashlib.sha256((HERE / 'oracle.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert ORACLE_HASH == '2de333f7380b3bb5762b259e9371cf0fd2f7a3feed33749345d1cafbb614f17d'
SESSION_DAY = Path(os.environ.get('CODEX_HOME', str(Path.home() / '.codex'))) / 'sessions/2026/09/05'
ROOT_THREAD = '01a07055-5f6b-71b3-94c0-673757e822ce'
CASE_MAP = {'standalone': 'standalone_board', 'acquire': 'understanding_acquire', 'synthesize': 'understanding_synthesize'}
records, pending = [], []
inventory = discover_desktop_sessions(SESSION_DAY, ROOT_THREAD)
assert not inventory['issues'], inventory['issues']
for ident, meta in inventory['sessions'].items():
    match = re.fullmatch(r'/root/bloat_probe_([bc])([123])_(standalone|acquire|synthesize)', str(meta.get('agent_path')))
    if not match:
        continue
    arm, repeat, suffix = match.groups()
    case = CASE_MAP[suffix]
    name = meta['agent_path'].split('/')[-1]
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(meta['path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines() if line.strip()]
    completions = [r['payload'] for r in rows if r['type'] == 'event_msg' and r['payload'].get('type') == 'task_complete']
    if not completions:
        pending.append(name)
        continue
    assert len(completions) == 1, 'a repeat must be a fresh single-turn task'
    end = completions[0]
    summary = collect_desktop_task(SESSION_DAY, ident, end['turn_id'])
    text = end.get('last_agent_message', '')
    try:
        output = json.loads(text)
        problems = oracle.check(case, output)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
        output = {'unparsed_final': text}
        problems = ['output_or_oracle_error:' + type(exc).__name__]
    out_dir = HERE / 'observations'
    out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / (name + '.output.json')).write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    quality = {'status': 'failed' if problems else 'passed', 'oracle': 'bloat_route_frozen_v1:' + ORACLE_HASH, 'output_fingerprint': None}
    record = make_record(workflow='csb_commission_preparation',
        workload_id=hashlib.sha256((HERE / (case + '.json')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        configuration={'observed_models': summary.get('observed_models'), 'reasoning_effort': 'high',
                       'runtime': 'Codex Desktop collaboration fork_none', 'execution_scope': 'read-only commission preparation',
                       'host': 'Windows same host; up to four concurrent leaves', 'case': case},
        revision='6d62b05aef99d541110b818157ec0ca10b85c305',
        elapsed_seconds=summary['elapsed_seconds'], outcome='failed' if problems or 'selected_turn_failed_or_aborted' in summary['issues'] else 'success',
        quality=quality, attempts=summary['attempts'],
        run_id=str(uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, json.dumps(['forseti-codex-desktop', ident, end['turn_id']]))),
        pair_id=repeat, case_id=case, arm='baseline' if arm == 'b' else 'candidate',
        agent_path=meta['agent_path'], source_thread_id=ident, source_turn_id=end['turn_id'],
        started_at=summary.get('root_started_at'), ended_at=summary.get('workunit_completed_at'),
        output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(), quality_issues=problems,
        source_state='base committed docs' if arm == 'b' else 'candidate working-tree docs on base')
    if summary['coverage'] != 'complete':
        record['usage']['coverage'] = 'unknown'
        record['usage']['issues'] = sorted(set(record['usage']['issues'] + summary['issues']))
    record['collection'] = {k: v for k, v in summary.items() if k != 'attempts'}
    (out_dir / (name + '.record.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    records.append(record)
records.sort(key=lambda r: (r['case_id'], r['pair_id'], r['arm']))
comparison = compare_runs([r for r in records if r['arm'] == 'baseline'], [r for r in records if r['arm'] == 'candidate'])
(HERE / 'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparison, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'completed': len(records), 'pending': pending,
    'runs': [{'name': r['agent_path'].split('/')[-1], 'total_tokens': r['usage'].get('total_tokens'),
              'cached_input_tokens': r['usage'].get('cached_input_tokens'), 'seconds': r['elapsed_seconds'],
              'coverage': r['usage']['coverage'], 'quality': r['quality']['status'], 'quality_issues': r['quality_issues']} for r in records]}, indent=2))
